evals.name: history-backed
evals.prompt: Deliver a code-first loan approval from form to updated balance. A refused loan must not affect the balance.
evals.expected_output: Single slice with precise boundary handoffs.
assertions: Separates command intent, returned fact and keyed projection.
Uses a generated query and command client, not hand-written proxies.
Checks the real screen result and a backend refusal without appending.

evals.name: ordinary-store
evals.prompt: A new preferences screen writes one ordinary database value; there is no history requirement. Plan delivery.
evals.expected_output: Minimal ordinary command and query path.
assertions: Does not require Chronicle or Screenplay.
Verifies the stored value via a scoped read and generated client.
Names an observable UI result and refusal case.

evals.name: partial-proof
evals.prompt: Registration appends successfully and a mocked story passes, but no live row appears. Can we call it done?
evals.expected_output: No; isolate the first missing handoff.
assertions: Checks keyed materialization before debugging the UI.
Checks the scoped query and client emission separately.
Requires a live journey rather than claiming mock evidence proves delivery.
